# Independent log parser fixtures

These lines are hand-written representative examples, not generated by `tools/log_aggregator.py` or its regexes.

- `json.log`: structured application event with an ISO-8601 timestamp, level, service, message, and request id.
- `text.log`: plain timestamped worker warning with bracketed service name.
- `nginx.log`: standard combined-style access line with a 503 response.
- `malformed.log`: incomplete JSON and incomplete nginx-shaped input used to verify graceful fallback/no crash behavior.
